findings.title: Deterministic UUID generation for legacy topics ignores subject_id, causing topic loss on identical names
findings.severity_justification: Direct unrecoverable data loss in catalog during migration. Whenever two disciplines share an identically named topic (e.g. 'Введение'), the second topic receives a duplicate UUID and is dropped from seen_topics.
findings.prerequisites: Legacy catalog (v1/v2) with identical topic names across different disciplines
findings.current_algorithm: deterministic_uuid('topic', normalize_name_key(tname)) hashes only kind and topic name. _parse_v1 checks 'if tid not in seen_topics', dropping the second topic.
findings.violated_invariant: Every topic defined under each discipline must be assigned a unique primary key and preserved.
findings.observable_evidence: AssertionError: Expected 4 topics, but found 3. 'Введение' in Subject 2 was dropped.
findings.impact: Catalog corruption and orphaned historical submissions.

remediation_option_a.name: Namespace topic UUIDs with subject_id
remediation_option_a.description: Incorporate subject_id into payload: json.dumps(['topic', str(subject_id), nfc_casefold_key]).
remediation_option_a.pros: 100% deterministic, robust subject namespacing, prevents any topic collisions.
remediation_option_a.cons: Changes deterministic UUID values for unversioned topics.
remediation_option_a.migration_impact: Requires re-running analyze if migrating from v1/v2.

remediation_option_b.name: Sequential fallback for duplicate topic names
remediation_option_b.description: If tid in seen_topics, append discriminator counter before hashing.
remediation_option_b.pros: Keeps original UUID for first topic.

findings.recommended_direction: Option A (incorporating subject_id into deterministic UUID payload).
findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: SELECT name_key, COUNT(*) FROM topics GROUP BY name_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
findings.backup_requirement: Full backup of legacy catalog and database before migration.

findings.title: apply_migration requires entities in mapping.json instead of importing from snapshot, breaking standard migration
findings.severity_justification: Completely breaks the standard offline migration command. The migration specification states mapping.entities is empty by default, but apply_migration fails with foreign key constraint violation because it does not insert catalog entities unless they are in mapping.json.
findings.prerequisites: Standard mapping generated by analyze with entities: {}
findings.current_algorithm: Iterates only mapping.get('entities', {}) to insert groups, subjects, topics into staging DB. Entities from catalog snapshot are never inserted.
findings.violated_invariant: Standard migration mapping with empty entities: {} must import the catalog graph from the catalog snapshot.
findings.observable_evidence: sqlite3.IntegrityError: FOREIGN KEY constraint failed during INSERT INTO students.
findings.impact: Migration aborts; target database cannot be published.

remediation_option_a.name: Import catalog snapshot entities in apply_migration
remediation_option_a.description: Insert groups, subjects, topics from catalog snapshot first, then apply any overrides/additions from mapping['entities'].
remediation_option_a.pros: Matches contract, decouples mapping file size from catalog size.

remediation_option_b.name: Always dump all entities into mapping.json in cmd_analyze
remediation_option_b.description: Force cmd_analyze to always serialize all catalog entities into mapping.json.
remediation_option_b.cons: Bloats mapping.json and violates separation between catalog and overrides.

findings.title: resolve_file_location builds flat topic map across all subjects, resolving hierarchical paths to wrong topics
findings.severity_justification: In hierarchical storage layouts Group/Subject/Topic/file.zip, the subject directory component is completely ignored. If multiple subjects have identically named topics, files are attributed to the wrong subject.
findings.prerequisites: Storage hierarchy with duplicate topic names across subjects
findings.current_algorithm: clean_topics_by_name = {clean_path_component(t.name): t.id for t in catalog.topics}. In len(dir_parts) >= 3, looks up dir_parts[-1] in flat map.
findings.violated_invariant: Hierarchical path resolution must match both subject and topic components.
findings.observable_evidence: Resolved topic ID belongs to Subject 2 instead of Subject 1.
findings.impact: Misattributed submission metadata in target database.

remediation_option_a.name: Scope topic lookup by subject component
remediation_option_a.description: In 3-part hierarchy, match dir_parts[1] against subject name and verify topic belongs to that subject.
remediation_option_a.pros: Accurate path resolution without false collisions.

remediation_option_b.name: Flag all identical topic names as ambiguous requiring manual mapping
remediation_option_b.description: Require manual mapping for any topic sharing a name.
remediation_option_b.cons: Unnecessary manual toil for clear 3-level folder trees.

findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: SELECT s.id, s.topic_id, t.subject_id FROM submissions s JOIN topics t ON t.id = s.topic_id;

findings.title: students table lacks index on group_id, forcing full table scan on student roster lookups
findings.severity_justification: Every student login, unlock, and submission dropdown load executes a full table scan (SCAN students) and in-memory sort (USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY).
findings.current_algorithm: UNIQUE(id, group_id) constraint leading column is id. Query WHERE group_id = ? cannot use the index.
findings.violated_invariant: High-frequency foreign key filters must utilize index lookups.
findings.observable_evidence: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shows 'SCAN students; USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY'.
findings.impact: O(N) CPU scaling on every student page load.

remediation_option_a.name: Add covering index on students
remediation_option_a.description: CREATE INDEX idx_students_group ON students(group_id, archived_at, display_name);
remediation_option_a.pros: Eliminates table scan and in-memory sort; O(log N) lookup.

remediation_option_b.name: Reorder composite UNIQUE constraint
remediation_option_b.pros: Covers group_id as leading column without extra index.

findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM students WHERE group_id = 'test';
findings.backup_requirement: Backup database before running CREATE INDEX.

findings.title: Lack of database pagination causes linear memory growth in list_submissions (~41 MB per 20k rows)
findings.severity_justification: Admin submissions history view loads all submissions into Python memory in a single query. At 20,000 submissions, peak memory is ~41.4 MB per request.
findings.current_algorithm: SELECT ... FROM submissions ... without LIMIT/OFFSET. Loads all records into Python heap.
findings.violated_invariant: Web views must bound heap allocations via database pagination.
findings.impact: Gunicorn worker memory exhaustion / OOM kills under concurrent admin access.

remediation_option_a.name: Server-side keyset or LIMIT/OFFSET pagination
remediation_option_a.description: Add limit and offset parameters to list_submissions; render pagination bar.

findings.title: Table-wide UNIQUE(name_key) on groups and subjects prevents reusing names of archived entities
findings.severity_justification: Prevents recreating academic groups with historical names in new academic periods.
findings.current_algorithm: Table-wide UNIQUE(name_key) constraint on groups and subjects.
findings.violated_invariant: Name conflict with active item rejected, but conflict with archived item allowed.
findings.observable_evidence: CatalogConflictError raised when creating group matching archived group name.
findings.impact: Operational block on re-using group names across school years.

remediation_option_a.name: Replace table-wide UNIQUE with partial index
remediation_option_a.description: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_groups_active_name ON groups(name_key) WHERE archived_at IS NULL;
remediation_option_a.pros: Enables reusing archived names, consistent with assignment_active_slot.

remediation_option_b.name: Mangle name_key on archive
remediation_option_b.description: UPDATE groups SET name_key = name_key || '__archived__' || id WHERE id = ?;

findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: SELECT name_key, COUNT(*) FROM groups WHERE archived_at IS NULL GROUP BY name_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

findings.title: apply_migration hardcodes NULL for archived_at, losing archival status of entities in mapping
findings.severity_justification: Archived groups/subjects in mapping.entities are inserted as active entities.
findings.prerequisites: mapping.json with archived_at set on entities
findings.current_algorithm: Hardcoded NULL in SQL: INSERT INTO groups ... VALUES (?, ?, ?, NULL).
findings.violated_invariant: Archived status and timestamps must be preserved.
findings.observable_evidence: Database row has archived_at = NULL after migration.

remediation_option_a.name: Read archived_at from mapping entity dict

findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: SELECT id, name, archived_at FROM groups WHERE archived_at IS NOT NULL;

findings.title: apply_migration silently ignores unknown/unexpected keys in mapping.json
findings.severity_justification: Typos in configuration (e.g. 'group_override') are silently ignored without error.
findings.current_algorithm: Accesses known keys via .get() without validating key set.
findings.violated_invariant: Strict schema validation must fail closed on unknown keys.
findings.observable_evidence: Migration completes successfully despite unknown top-level and sub-level keys.

remediation_option_a.name: Validate mapping schema against allowed key set

findings.title: apply_migration accepts empty or whitespace-only non_submission_reason strings
findings.severity_justification: Files can be silently skipped without explanation by passing whitespace.
findings.current_algorithm: if finfo.get('non_submission_reason'): continue evaluates unstripped string.
findings.violated_invariant: non_submission_reason must be non-empty stripped string.
findings.observable_evidence: apply_migration ignores file with non_submission_reason='   ' without error.

remediation_option_a.name: Validate stripped non_submission_reason
remediation_option_a.description: if finfo.get('non_submission_reason') is not None and not finfo['non_submission_reason'].strip(): raise ValueError(...).

remediation_option_b.name: Disallow non_submission_reason entirely
remediation_option_b.description: Require all files to be submissions.

findings.title: migrate_v2.py does not validate calendar date validity, publishing '2026-02-30'
findings.severity_justification: Calendar-invalid dates (e.g. Feb 30) pass DDL GLOB check and corrupt class_assignments.
findings.current_algorithm: Relies solely on SQLite CHECK(lesson_date GLOB '????-??-??').
findings.violated_invariant: All lesson dates must be valid calendar dates.

remediation_option_b.name: Enforce date validity in DDL
remediation_option_b.description: CHECK(date(lesson_date) IS NOT NULL AND date(lesson_date) = lesson_date)

findings.recommended_direction: Option A (and Option B on next schema revision).
findings.read_only_diagnostic_sql: SELECT id, lesson_date FROM class_assignments WHERE date(lesson_date) IS NULL OR date(lesson_date) != lesson_date;

findings.title: AccessStore.configure() suffers from lost update race on access version
findings.severity_justification: Concurrent administrative updates overwrite version instead of incrementing monotonically.
findings.current_algorithm: SELECT version, compute new_version in Python, UPDATE group_access SET version = ?.
findings.violated_invariant: Version must increment monotonically on every configuration update.
findings.observable_evidence: Two concurrent calls resulted in version 8 instead of 9.
findings.impact: Failure to revoke stale student sessions.

remediation_option_a.name: Atomic SQL increment
remediation_option_a.description: UPDATE group_access SET version = version + 1, ... WHERE group_id = ?;

remediation_option_b.name: Optimistic concurrency check
remediation_option_b.description: UPDATE ... WHERE group_id = ? AND version = ? with retry.

findings.title: Tampered/invalid filter values in /admin/submissions cause unhandled HTTP 500
findings.severity_justification: Uncaught ValueError on invalid UUID query parameter crashes worker and returns 500.
findings.violated_invariant: Client query errors must return HTTP 400 or ignore invalid filter, never HTTP 500.
findings.impact: Denial of service and error log pollution.

remediation_option_a.name: Catch ValueError and abort(400)
remediation_option_a.description: Wrap UUID parsing in try/except ValueError: abort(400).

remediation_option_b.name: Ignore invalid UUID and treat as None

findings.title: Relative DATABASE_PATH from .env.example results in duplicate prefix '.private/.private/app_v2.sqlite3'
findings.severity_justification: App fails to start with .env.example defaults unless nested .private/.private directory is created.
findings.current_algorithm: if not db_path.is_absolute(): db_path = private_dir / db_path prepends private_dir twice.
findings.violated_invariant: Relative database path from .env.example must resolve cleanly without duplicate prefix.
findings.impact: Startup failure under standard deployment configuration.

remediation_option_a.name: Idempotent path resolution
remediation_option_a.description: Check if db_path already starts with private_dir before prepending.

findings.title: Admin assignment update returns HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 409 when topic has submissions
findings.severity_justification: Minor REST API contract mismatch (400 vs 409).
findings.prerequisites: Updating topic on assignment with existing submissions
findings.impact: Client UI cannot differentiate generic validation error from topic conflict.

remediation_option_b.name: Update API contract to document HTTP 400

findings.title: Flask session cookies lack explicit SameSite=Lax configuration
findings.severity_justification: Leaves session cookies vulnerable to cross-site request forgery on older browser engines.
findings.current_algorithm: Default Flask session cookies omit SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE.
findings.violated_invariant: Session cookies must explicitly specify SameSite='Lax' and HttpOnly=True.

ruled_out_hypotheses.title: Nested transaction under 'with conn:' before 'BEGIN IMMEDIATE'
ruled_out_hypotheses.details: Investigated whether using 'with connect(...) as conn:' followed by 'conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE;")' in SubmissionStore.submit raises sqlite3.OperationalError: cannot start a transaction within a transaction. In Python's sqlite3 module, standard connections allow manual transaction control statements without nesting errors when managed cleanly. The audit test suite executed over 300 atomic submissions across crash recovery, concurrency, and scaling tests without a single transaction nesting error. Ruled out as an active defect.

ruled_out_hypotheses.title: Historical reviewed submissions with NULL reviewed_at violates DDL CHECK constraint
ruled_out_hypotheses.details: Investigated whether legacy reviewed submissions that lack a reviewed_at timestamp violate schema constraint CHECK(review_status='reviewed' OR reviewed_at IS NULL). In schema_v2.sql, the logical condition is 'review_status="reviewed" OR reviewed_at IS NULL'. When review_status is 'reviewed', the disjunction evaluates to True regardless of whether reviewed_at is NULL or a valid ISO timestamp. Only 'pending' submissions with non-null reviewed_at are rejected. Ruled out as an active defect.
